howItWorks.title: How WonZo works
howItWorks.intro: Good to know before you order.
howItWorks.sourceTitle: Where do the products come from?
howItWorks.sourceText: WonZo works with a wholesaler in Europe. Your order ships straight to you from their warehouse. Every product shows which country it ships from.
howItWorks.deliveryText: Every product shows a delivery time in working days. You see it again in your cart and before you pay. We don't promise next-day delivery, because we can't keep that promise.
howItWorks.stockText: We only show products that are in stock. When something sells out, it disappears from the shop.
howItWorks.returnsText: You have 14 days to change your mind after receipt. How to send a product back and what it costs will be on the returns page once the shop opens.

returns.metaDescription: Send a WonZo order back: within 14 days without a reason, and always when something is wrong, damaged or defective.
returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Not happy, or something not right? Register your return here. You need the email address of your order and your invoice number.
returns.how1: You have 14 days from the day you receive the parcel to change your mind. Within that time you may send everything back without a reason.
returns.how2: If something was delivered wrong, damaged or defective, you can also send it back after those 14 days.
returns.how3: Your parcel contains a return label. With it you send the parcel back for free.
returns.how4: If you send everything back, you also get the shipping costs back. We refund you as soon as we have received and checked the parcel, to the account or card you paid with.
returns.addressText: Lost the label? Contact us at {email}.
returns.invoiceHint: It is on your invoice, for example 2026-00042. You find the invoice through the link in your confirmation email, and in the email that your parcel is on its way.
returns.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
returns.invoiceInvalid: Enter the invoice number as it is on your invoice, for example 2026-00042.

returns.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
returns.chooseIntro: Order {reference}. Choose for each item how many you send back and why.

returns.errorQuantity: Choose a number you can still send back.

returns.summaryNote: You get the shipping costs back when you send everything back, and the own shipping costs of a large item when it is wrong, damaged or defective. If an item has been used more than needed to check it, the amount can be lower.
returns.doneText: Return number {number}. We have emailed you the steps below.
returns.step1: Pack the items well, preferably in the original packaging.
returns.step2: Stick the return label from your parcel on it.
returns.step3: Send the parcel back within 14 days.
returns.doneMax: You get at most {amount} back, once we have received and checked the parcel.
